review_evidence: Inventoried all 696 primary Lean files across ten unsorry archive packages (0003, 0018, 0032, 0039, 0058, 0063, 0080, 0089, 0121 and 0131): exactly 348 goal files and 348 paired library files.

A complete source-shape scan found a theorem/lemma/definition-style declaration in every one of the 696 files. All 348 goal files contain sorry as the proof hole for their mathematical statement, while none of the 348 paired library files contains sorry.

Representative pairs include elementary number theory, finite sums, inequalities and combinatorial statements together with their Unsorry library proofs. There is no declaration-free or tooling-only formal source in this unit to remove from primary search.
summary: Reviewed this ten-package unsorry archive slice; all 696 files are mathematical goal statements or corresponding proved library modules, so the complete unit remains primary-retained.
